references.name: NIBS Duplex Apartment (IFC2X3 coordination view)
references.description: Two-unit duplex apartment, 3 storeys plus a footing pseudo-storey, flat roof, 2 stairs. Revit Architecture 2011 export, Coordination View. Target for F3.

source.officialDownloadStatus: portal.nibs.org timed out (TCP connect, 60 s, repeated) from the build host on 2026-11-08, and the Wayback Machine holds only the landing page, not the zip. The zip's SHA-256 is therefore not recorded and the bytes below are not byte-verified against it.
provenanceEvidence: Header: FILE_DESCRIPTION 'ViewDefinition [CoordinationView]', FILE_NAME timestamp 2011-09-07, 'Autodesk Revit Architecture 2011', matching the NIBS '2011-09-14 Duplex IFC 2x3 Coordination MVD' description.
Content: storeys Level 1 / Level 2 / Roof, spaces A101..B205 and R301, matching the Duplex model.

Independent public copy with identical bytes (git blob 8210b5f627e92ea888252c318481babce31059c5, 2,380,763 bytes): https://github.com/ThatOpen/engine_web-ifc/blob/bbb34120e2dd2659836d849f84cf97d5f47e6587/tests/ifcfiles/public/duplex.ifc

licence.attribution: National Institute of Building Sciences (NIBS), Common Building Information Model Files; Duplex Apartment model by Kristine Fallon Associates from a student design
licence.caveat: Neither the WBDG page nor the NIBS disclaimer grants a licence for the model files. The disclaimer says 'Neither the United States Government nor NIBS ... makes any warranty' and the footer reads '(c) 2023 National Institute of Building Sciences. All rights reserved.' The page is credited to the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers ERDC-CERL, but the model was made by a contractor, so no public-domain status is assumed. Treated as not redistributable: referenced by URL and hash only. The bytes used here come from the repo's own fixture release (tests/models/ara3d/duplex.ifc), which this lane did not create.

targetNotes: T/FDN is a footing pseudo-storey at -1.25 m, not an occupied level; the occupied levels are Level 1 (0.0), Level 2 (3.1) and Roof (6.0).
Space areas are net floor areas measured on the space mesh; the file also carries Revit 'GSA BIM Area' (gross) as areaProperty, which is 10-30% larger.
The roof is a flat roof ('Basic Roof: Live Roof over Wood Joist Flat Roof'); the F3 spec has no pitched roof to match.
Revit exports no base quantities, so wall lengths come from each wall's Axis polyline.

references.name: KIT AC20-FZK-Haus (IFC4)
references.description: Small phantasy two-storey house, ArchiCAD 20 IFC4. Target for F2 (see README: it has a 30 degree gable roof, not a hip roof, and is 12 x 10 m).
references.authoringTool: GRAPHISOFT ARCHICAD-64 20.0.0 GER FULL Windows (via EXPRESS Data Manager 5.02.0100.09)

source.note: KIT's own site (iai.kit.edu / iai.fzk.de) no longer serves the file; the IFC Wiki page 'KIT IFC Examples' is the maintained origin. The repo fixture ara3d/AC20-FZK-Haus.ifc (sha256 d42ab0de..., 2,526,511 bytes) is a different export of the same house and must not be confused with this file.

licence.caveat: A statement on a wiki page, not a licence text with an SPDX id and not on a KIT-hosted page. 'Unrestricted use' probably covers redistribution but does not say so. The bytes are therefore never committed; attribution is kept anyway.

targetNotes: 12.0 x 10.0 m footprint, 2 storeys (Erdgeschoss 0.0, Dachgeschoss 2.7), one IfcStair, 5 doors, 11 windows, 7 spaces.

The roof is two IfcSlab(ROOF) planes forming a gable at 30 degrees; there is no hip. The F2 brief in the contract says '10x8 m ... hip roof': either the brief or the reference choice needs a decision.
Space 'Galerie' (attic) is 107.16 m2 gross floor area per BaseQuantities.
Wall lengths are summed from each wall's Axis polyline (113.80 m). The file's own BaseQuantities.Length sums to 109.66 m (3.6% lower, net of joins); both are within the 5% wall-length tolerance.
